taxonomy_name: SUPREMESETUHUB GLOBAL COMPANY AND BUSINESS TAXONOMY
coverage_intent: Worldwide, country-aware directory covering registered entities and clearly distinguished non-corporate businesses and service providers.

adult_business_listing_policy: Metadata and business-directory listings only; this taxonomy does not authorize hosting, distributing, or generating explicit media.
The business and activity must be lawful in every relevant operating jurisdiction.
Age-restricted businesses must use legally required age gates and access controls.
Any sexual content or service must involve consenting adults only; exploitation, coercion, trafficking, and non-consensual material are prohibited.
Never list, host, link to, or facilitate sexual content involving minors or people whose age cannot be established.
Do not publish private sexual information, intimate images, or sensitive personal data.
Apply applicable licensing, consumer-protection, privacy, advertising, payment-provider, and platform rules.
Where legality or age/consent safeguards cannot be established, exclude the listing or mark it as restricted_pending_review.

record_requirements.country_specific_identifiers: Store identifiers in country-specific fields or a namespaced identifier collection. Never assume one global company-number format.

notes: A-Z is a navigation and search feature, not a claim that every company in the world is present.
Registered legal entities, informal businesses, sole proprietors, freelancers, and individual professionals must remain distinguishable.
Industry, business size, audience, and verification are separate dimensions and must not be conflated.
A source directory entry is not a live API connection and is not proof that a company record has been verified.
Global coverage must be built country by country using official, licensed, or otherwise authorized sources.
Do not scrape access-controlled systems, bypass CAPTCHAs, or misrepresent incomplete country coverage.
Do not infer legal registration, licensing, safety, or regulatory compliance from an industry classification.
Adult-related categories are for lawful adult-oriented businesses and services only, subject to the safeguards above.

record_types.description: Registered legal entities and formally constituted organizations.
Operating businesses, including MSMEs, startups, sole proprietors and franchises.
Independent individual professionals and service providers.

record_type_policy: record_type is the top-level directory class; entity_type is the legal or operational subtype. These are separate dimensions.
